entries.name: PHP target and native oracle admission
entries.contract: New compilation targets PHP 8.3; live comparison requires a stable PHP 8.3 release at or above 8.3.36. Newer series require explicit enablement and their own validation.

assertions: numeric patch floor, stable release syntax and selected-series identity enforced
retired and unverified series cannot auto-enable
frontend and direct IR reject retired and unverified targets without output
live metadata gate rejects old/mismatched/missing oracles and records admitted identity before tests

limitations: Admission is not a compatibility or vulnerability-free guarantee for later patches
Only pinned and measured oracle versions have differential evidence
Historical snapshots remain readable with retired targets and older patch versions; no current support inferred

entries.name: Named functions with fixed value parameters and return
entries.contract: Lowers declared named functions, fixed value arguments and explicit returns in the closed subset.

assertions: native PHP stdout equals generated Go stdout

limitations: No optional, typed, variadic or by-reference parameters
No closures or dynamic calls

entries.name: foreach over supported arrays
entries.contract: Iterates ordered GoHP arrays and binds value or key/value variables.

assertions: key and value iteration output matches native PHP
scalar foreach is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No by-reference iteration
Only supported array values

entries.name: Short and legacy array literals
entries.contract: Lowers ordered [] and case-insensitive array(...) literals with supported integer and string keys and values.

assertions: mixed keys, nested reads and count output match
empty legacy arrays, mixed-case array spelling, literal keys, nested reads, trailing commas, function returns and foreach output match
explicit maximum integer key behavior matches
legacy array references are rejected with a diagnostic code
legacy array unpacking is rejected with a diagnostic code
legacy array dynamic keys are rejected with a diagnostic code
legacy array empty holes are rejected with a diagnostic code
legacy array mismatched delimiters are rejected with a diagnostic code
nested legacy array mismatched delimiters are rejected with a diagnostic code
bare legacy array keyword is rejected with a diagnostic code
automatic key after maximum integer fails explicitly

limitations: No array union or writes
No references or unpacking
Only literal integer/string keys; dynamic and boolean keys are rejected

entries.name: Array index reads
entries.contract: Reads supported array values by supported keys.

assertions: nested and keyed reads match fixture output
missing key runtime failure is not reported as a pass

limitations: Missing-key behavior is an explicit GoHP runtime failure, not a PHP warning-equivalence claim
No index writes

entries.name: Classes, no-argument construction and methods
entries.contract: Lowers classes with public scalar defaults, no-argument construction, property reads and methods in the closed subset.

assertions: method dispatch and public property read output match
missing property is rejected
wrong method arity is rejected

limitations: No inheritance, constructors, visibility, static members, traits or interfaces

entries.name: Binary +
entries.contract: Performs supported integral addition and rejects statically known invalid operands.

assertions: integer accumulation output matches
int64 overflow fails explicitly

limitations: No float promotion
Only limited numeric-string coercion

entries.name: Binary .
entries.contract: Concatenates supported values using GoHP runtime conversion.

assertions: target-version precedence output matches

limitations: Only supported value types
No complete PHP string conversion semantics

entries.name: Parentheses and target-specific +/. precedence
entries.contract: Parses the closed expression grammar with PHP 8.3 precedence for addition and concatenation.

assertions: generated output equals the selected native PHP target
parenthesized integral addition output matches

limitations: Only +, . and parentheses are covered

entries.name: Braced one-arm if statements
entries.contract: Lowers one-arm if statements with a braced body and preserves writes to variables that were defined before the conditional.

assertions: nested conditions, early returns and assignments to an existing variable match native PHP
else is rejected
elseif is rejected
unbraced if body is rejected
a variable first assigned only in an if body is not available outside it

limitations: No else, elseif, alternative syntax or unbraced body
Variables first assigned in an if body are not definitely assigned after it

entries.name: Logical &&
entries.contract: Evaluates supported truthiness values left-to-right and short-circuits the right operand.

assertions: a marker-producing right operand is skipped for false and evaluated once for true
guarded strtolower does not receive non-string dynamic values
logical || is rejected

limitations: No ||, xor, and/or keyword operators or general PHP truthiness

entries.name: Strict scalar equality ===
entries.contract: Compares null, bool, int64 and string values by both type and value.

assertions: integer and string values with the same spelling remain distinct
strict comparison participates in target-specific precedence
runtime rejects array identity semantics explicitly
array strict equality is rejected
unparenthesized non-associative strict-equality chain is rejected

limitations: No array or object identity semantics
No loose equality

entries.name: Loose equality ==
entries.contract: No PHP coercive equality lowering is provided.

assertions: loose equality is rejected

limitations: PHP type-juggling equality is unsupported

entries.name: (bool) cast
entries.contract: Casts supported null, bool, int64, string and array values using the documented GoHP truthiness subset.

assertions: false, null, zero, string zero and empty string are false
nonempty strings and a nonempty array are true
unsupported truthiness types fail explicitly
non-boolean casts are rejected

limitations: No object/resource truthiness
No casts other than (bool)

entries.name: is_bool
entries.contract: Returns whether a supported dynamic value is bool.

assertions: boolean, string and array predicate results match native PHP
missing argument is rejected
extra argument is rejected
builtin redeclaration is rejected

limitations: Exactly one argument
No PHP extension type values

entries.name: is_string
entries.contract: Returns whether a supported dynamic value is string.

assertions: boolean, string and array predicate results match native PHP
missing argument is rejected
extra argument is rejected
builtin redeclaration is rejected

limitations: Exactly one argument
No PHP extension type values

entries.name: strtolower(string)
entries.contract: Lowers ASCII byte case conversion for one string argument; The owned differential fixture selects and verifies LC_CTYPE=C.

assertions: ASCII uppercase strings lower correctly
is_string guard short-circuits non-string inputs before the runtime string guard
runtime rejects non-string input
missing argument is rejected
extra argument is rejected
integer input is rejected
boolean input is rejected
null input is rejected
array input is rejected
builtin redeclaration is rejected

limitations: Exactly one string argument
ASCII byte mapping only
No locale-sensitive or Unicode case mapping
No non-string coercion

entries.name: int64, string, bool and null literals
entries.contract: Represents the listed scalar literals in the closed subset.

assertions: bool and null concatenation output matches fixture

limitations: No floats, interpolation, complete casts or PHP type-juggling semantics

entries.name: count(array)
entries.contract: Supports one-argument, nonrecursive count for GoHP arrays only.

assertions: array count output matches
count on a scalar is rejected

limitations: No recursive or explicit second-argument mode
No PHP count behavior for arbitrary Countable values
Scalar rejection is not PHP warning/exception equivalence

entries.name: rtrim(string, literal-mask)
entries.contract: Supports exactly two arguments: a string or dynamic value guarded at runtime, and a string literal byte mask without character ranges.

assertions: empty, unchanged, repeated slash/backslash, literal and empty masks, nested calls, case-insensitive calls, UTF-8 and byte-split output match native PHP
omitted default mask is rejected
extra argument is rejected
integer input is rejected
boolean input is rejected
null input is rejected
array input is rejected
dynamic mask is rejected
range mask is rejected
reserved function redeclaration is rejected
byte-mask trimming preserves the expected raw bytes including incomplete UTF-8
runtime rejects dynamic non-string input and range masks

limitations: No default mask
No coercion of non-string input
Mask must be a literal
No '..' character ranges
Trimming is byte-wise and may produce invalid UTF-8

entries.name: strlen
entries.contract: No lowering is provided.
limitations: Not supported

entries.name: array_map
entries.contract: No lowering is provided.
limitations: Callbacks and closures are unsupported

entries.name: json_encode
entries.contract: No lowering is provided.
limitations: Go JSON behavior must not be assumed PHP-equivalent

entries.name: Closures and callbacks
entries.contract: Closure syntax fails closed.

assertions: closure source is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No callback or dynamic-call support

entries.name: Array writes and references
entries.contract: Array element assignment and reference assignment fail closed.

assertions: array element assignment is rejected
reference assignment is rejected

limitations: Copy-on-write and PHP reference semantics are not implemented

entries.name: include and require
entries.contract: Include syntax fails closed.

assertions: include source is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No autoloading, include paths or Composer resolver

entries.name: Floating-point literals and values
entries.contract: Float literals fail closed.

assertions: float literal source is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No PHP floating-point or promotion semantics

entries.name: mysqli, PDO and SQLite extensions
entries.contract: No extension bindings or database operations are provided.
limitations: No credentials, DB writes or extension equivalence claim

entries.name: gohp CLI generation and artifact publication
entries.contract: Writes fresh generated Go and optional report artifacts without replacing existing or aliased destinations.

assertions: fresh output and report are written with consistent hashes
existing and aliased destinations are preserved
tested path-validation and generation failures leave no newly published artifacts

limitations: A successful generation report is not a PHP compatibility pass
No crash-atomic two-file publication; cleanup may fail on filesystem errors
Requires hard-link support and a private, non-concurrently-mutated workspace

entries.name: Statement-level PHP-to-Go source maps
entries.contract: Publishes final formatted Go line ranges mapped to PHP statement start lines.

assertions: nested statements, methods and formatted output map to expected PHP lines
unknown positions are omitted and failed generation leaks no map
a real generated Go panic frame resolves to the failing PHP statement

limitations: Not Source Map v3
No columns, multiple source files, debugger integration or PHP semantic guarantee

entries.name: Read-only archived compatibility views
entries.contract: Reads hash-bound catalog/event archives, replays stored verdicts and filters feature rows without merging runs or hiding overall failures.

assertions: pass/fail/skip archives replay without source files
changed hashes, verdicts, phases, duplicates and escaping symlinks are rejected
target and status filters retain each run, its overall failure, configuration and all cases
archive text cannot insert raw HTML or Markdown links

limitations: Internal consistency only, not authenticity, source revalidation or CI job success
No latest/best selection, revision applicability or combined-target support verdict
No PHP language compatibility claim from these Go-only tooling tests
